description: Accepted performance changes on main, one series per frozen workload. Each step is a before/after pair measured in the same run, so steps from different hosts chain as ratios rather than mixing absolute times. Append with tools/render_competitor_card.py record, which re-renders the competitor card.

series.label: MarkDuplicates, paired, ~600k records
series.protocol: one CPU, compression level 1, warm cache, one warm-up plus three alternating measured repetitions; before and after measured in the same run

series.label: MarkDuplicates, paired spill, ~1.2M records
series.protocol: one CPU, compression level 1, warm cache, one warm-up plus three alternating measured repetitions; before and after measured in the same run
